evidence.name: Screen field: Even grid cell heights
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Even grid cell heights" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Even grid cell heights
sections.description: On a grid, choose whether all cells stretch to the same maximum height for tidy, even rows, or each cell sizes to its own content (giving rows of varying height). Turn it on for a clean, consistent grid; turn it off when items have very different content lengths. Only applies to grid layouts.
